title: Raku Ho'olaule'a 2026
evidence_sentence: Hawaii Potters' Guild organizes potters to attend this annual raku firing event at a beach campout, where participants sign up for firing, glazing, and cleanup shifts.
evidence_quote: ceramic artists to participate in raku and related firing techniques at a campout
summary: A week-long raku firing event on Oahu's North Shore where potters fire glazed work, with juried exhibition by raku specialists. Participants register with Hawaii Potters' Guild ($60 HPG fee plus meals) and must work crew shifts for setup, firing, and cleanup.
commitment: Mon load · Fri-Sun fire · Sun unload, plus crew shifts for setup and breakdown
bring: Glazed pots, communal supplies (1 table per person), small selection of tea bowls and sake cups for public events
cost_text: $60 HPG fee (van rental, kiawe wood, HPG supplies) plus meals ($86 for all meals or à la carte)
pay_text: HPG fee $60, optional meal costs $86 or à la carte
how_to_join: Register with Hawaii Craftsmen for Raku Ho'olaule'a, then register with Hawaii Potters' Guild and pay HPG fees and meal costs
